J=len(case['windows'])
mod = 'testcnnonnx' if case['model']=='cnn' else 'testrnnonnx'
preds = __import__(mod).evaluate_model_single_pass(np.array([w[7] for w in case['windows']],dtype=np.int64).reshape(J,9,2), np.zeros(J,dtype=np.int64))
th=window_thresholds(case['stats'],case['windows'])
times=[s[0] for s in case['slots']]; caps=[s[1] for s in case['slots']]; refills=[s[2] for s in case['slots']]

value=[case['windows'][j][6]*case['class_values'][preds[j]] for j in range(J)]
passes=[case['windows'][j][5]<th[j] for j in range(J)]
lo=[planner.bisect_left(times,wready[j]) for j in range(J)]
hi=[planner.bisect_right(times,wexpires[j])-1 for j in range(J)]

        for s in range(lo[j],hi[j]+1): sw[s].append(j)

net.lo=lo;net.hi=hi;net.ftgt=ftgt

net.assigned=[-1]*J; net.wdist=[planner.BIG]*J; net.pi=[0]*net.n if False else [0]*net.n
